message: 甘ければいーじゃない
Just as I had admitted to him myself, writing the lyrics isn't going well. For a change of pace, I brewed some black tea using a tea server very similar to the one in the Student Council room.
It smells lovely.
However, the humidity in my room went up. Moisture is the sworn enemy of books.
I open the window to air out my room.
For no particular reason, I let out a breath.
It's white.
Even though I haven't drunk any tea yet, it's already pure white.
I'm sure the wharf must be even colder.
I realize my shoulders are slumping in disappointment.
It's already winter. That means having dinner with him on the park bench is on hold until spring.

name: Misa
message: 「Thank you, God.」
I don't know if God really exists or not.
Even so, I murmur my gratitude toward the heavens.
Back then, as we were parting at the wharf, a foghorn blared right as I tried to tell him.
So I'm sure my voice never reached his ears.
I think that's for the best.
...I've decided to think of it that way!
I only blurted that out because I got swept up in the mood!!
I mean, why am I getting so worked up anyway!?

name: Misa
message: 「...Inhale. ...Exhale.」
I try taking a deep breath.
No effect. My heart hasn't calmed down one bit.
...I'm amazing just because I'm the captain, you say?
Then what does that make you!? Aren't you the Student Council President, who's way more amazing than the choir captain!!
Even though you're always walking one step ahead of me!!
W-Well, sure, even I'm happy that you have high hopes for me, but...

name: Misa
message: 「Ah...!? Shake, shake, shake!」
I frantically shake my head.
Before I knew it, I'd upgraded him from "him" to "you."
Inside the plastic shopping bag I was holding, jars of jam clinked together briskly.
The logo printed on it was "Inamiya," a supermarket I'd never even shopped at before.
After that, when I went to the shopping district to buy dinner, I ended up bumping right into you.
It felt awkward, like I was slacking off on writing the lyrics, yet you didn't seem to think twice about it.
--Hey Misa, good work today.
--Hey, did you know? Even Inamiya has some pretty great bargains.
--Oh, right! I've got something good! I just redeemed some points for it a little while ago.
--Here, strawberry jam.
―And what's more, ta―da! Look, there are three of them!
--Foreigners put strawberry jam in their black tea, right? Even I know that much.
--Sweets are essential when you're studying. Use them to help write your lyrics.

name: Misa
message: 「F-Foreigners, you say? What's with that broad generalization?!」
The words slip out of my mouth before I can stop them.
Of course, there's no reply. This is my bedroom, and you don't even know where my house is.
Certainly, just as you say, there are countries where people drink it like that.
...We don't do that in my family, though!
Geez, you really don't have a clue!
Still...
Every now and then, drinking it like that might not be so bad.
I take the small jars of jam out of the plastic shopping bag.

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?!」
Seeing the labels on the little jars, I let out a bizarre, startled squeak.
『Very Sweet Strawberry Jam』
『Super Sweet Strawberry Jam』
『Crazy Sweet Strawberry Jam』
Three varieties of strawberry jam, each packed into its own small jar.
To be frank, I can't tell the difference at all.
What is this, sarcasm?! Are you trying to fatten me up? Don't you know I'm always on a diet?!
...You really don't know, do you?
So this present is definitely just you being airheaded.

name: Misa
message: 「Giggle...」
Still looking up at the night sky where I just thanked God, my cheeks soften into a smile.
The dark hours that used to fill me with nothing but anxiety ever since I was little.
Used to--past tense.
Was it around the time of the exams? I stopped being afraid of the night.

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, welcome ho~me.」
I close the window and head over to greet them.

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, Father... Yes, yes, you don't have to rush me so much, I'm opening it right now!」
Just from hearing the sound of the doorbell, I can already tell whether it's Father or Mother who has come home.
Hurrying toward the front door, I let out a lighthearted scolding.

name: Misa
message: 「Good grief, Father is so childish!」
